q1_issues.issue: The scale slot of (Measure sk_mire_essence_1 quantity ...) is filled with 'quantity', which no word in the clause supplies — Measures & units reserves the symbol 'unspecified' for an unstated dimension and says a scale no word supplies is never invented ('duration' at statement 20 is the same borrowing, though a time unit makes it more defensible).

(Past (BeforeBy now sk_new_moon_1 12 day)) wraps a temporal-ordering relation in Past, which Status predicates licenses only over an event witness or a categorical/copular atom, and the reading is incoherent ('it was the case that now is twelve days before the new moon'); the reference point of 'twelve days away' is the day-21 report, not the speech-time constant now.

new_moon is fused as a compound kind but gets none of the decomposition atoms Compound concepts makes mandatory — no genus (Inheritance new_moon moon) and no adjectival modifier genus — while every other compound in this parse (cold_snap, salt_bloom_store, winter_supply, harvest_party, mire_essence, salt_bloom_harvest_party) does get its genus.

q2_gaps: Measure-phrase NPs quantifying a mass noun — 'one and a half vessels of mire-essence', 'eight weeks of winter supply' — have no encoding: Possessive / genitive NP explicitly excludes the measure of-phrase ('a cup of water') but nothing replaces it, and no word supplies a scale for the Measure form the parse fell back on.

A temporal-distance predication inside a seal whose reference point is the matrix event's time ('the next new moon was twelve days away'): ordering atoms may not cross a seal boundary, so the report event cannot anchor it, and the only licensed anchor, the speech-time constant now, is the wrong time.

'next' as a restrictive modifier on an entity NP ('the next new moon') has no licensed carrier — the 'next / last Tuesday' rule covers only time adverbials, where the clause's tense carries the direction.

A mandative subjunctive that-complement ('proposed that Coraline Ash join ...') — a tenseless finite-shaped complement — is not addressed by Propositional attitudes, which assumes a tensed finite clause or a to-infinitive control complement.
notes: Seal discipline is handled carefully and correctly throughout: report/propose/agree stay non-factive with Experiencer holders and no top-level predication of P, definite and named typing plus compound genus atoms project while indefinite witnesses and the Northcove Possession stay sealed, and both embedded 'would' complements take (Future e) inside the seal per Sequence of tense. Roles are right too, including Agent on the stative transitive 'held' and Patient on the created harvest party.
